name: DFE ClickHouse Overview
description: The ClickHouse numbers an operator checks first, read straight from the server's own system tables.

config.name: Queries running
config.sqlTemplate:
SELECT argMax(CurrentMetric_Query, event_time) AS "Queries running"
FROM merge('system', '^metric_log')
WHERE $__dateTimeFilter(event_date, event_time)

config.name: Failed queries
config.sqlTemplate:
SELECT countIf(type IN ('ExceptionBeforeStart', 'ExceptionWhileProcessing')) AS "Failed queries"
FROM system.query_log
WHERE $__dateTimeFilter(event_date, event_time)

config.name: Max parts per partition
config.sqlTemplate:
SELECT max(value) AS "Max parts per partition"
FROM merge('system', '^asynchronous_metric_log')
WHERE metric = 'MaxPartCountForPartition' AND $__dateTimeFilter(event_date, event_time)

config.name: Merges running
config.sqlTemplate:
SELECT argMax(CurrentMetric_Merge, event_time) AS "Merges running"
FROM merge('system', '^metric_log')
WHERE $__dateTimeFilter(event_date, event_time)

config.name: Memory tracked
config.sqlTemplate:
SELECT argMax(CurrentMetric_MemoryTracking, event_time) AS "Memory tracked"
FROM merge('system', '^metric_log')
WHERE $__dateTimeFilter(event_date, event_time)

config.name: Fullest disk
config.sqlTemplate:
SELECT max(1 - free_space / total_space) AS "Disk used"
FROM system.disks
WHERE total_space > 0

config.name: Queries per second
config.sqlTemplate:
SELECT toStartOfInterval(event_time, INTERVAL $__interval_s SECOND) AS ts,
       avg(ProfileEvent_Query) AS "All queries",
       avg(ProfileEvent_SelectQuery) AS "SELECT",
       avg(ProfileEvent_InsertQuery) AS "INSERT"
FROM merge('system', '^metric_log')
WHERE $__dateTimeFilter(event_date, event_time)
GROUP BY ts
ORDER BY ts

config.name: Query duration percentiles
config.sqlTemplate:
SELECT $__timeInterval(event_time) AS ts,
       quantile(0.5)(query_duration_ms) AS "p50",
       quantile(0.9)(query_duration_ms) AS "p90",
       quantile(0.99)(query_duration_ms) AS "p99"
FROM system.query_log
WHERE type = 'QueryFinish' AND $__dateTimeFilter(event_date, event_time)
GROUP BY ts
ORDER BY ts

config.name: Query failures
config.sqlTemplate:
SELECT $__timeInterval(event_time) AS ts,
       countIf(type = 'ExceptionBeforeStart') AS "Rejected before start",
       countIf(type = 'ExceptionWhileProcessing') AS "Failed mid-flight"
FROM system.query_log
WHERE $__dateTimeFilter(event_date, event_time)
GROUP BY ts
ORDER BY ts

config.name: Rows read and written per second
config.sqlTemplate:
SELECT toStartOfInterval(event_time, INTERVAL $__interval_s SECOND) AS ts,
       avg(ProfileEvent_SelectedRows) AS "Selected rows",
       avg(ProfileEvent_InsertedRows) AS "Inserted rows"
FROM merge('system', '^metric_log')
WHERE $__dateTimeFilter(event_date, event_time)
GROUP BY ts
ORDER BY ts

config.name: Most expensive query shapes
config.sqlTemplate:
SELECT normalizeQuery(any(query)) AS "Query",
       count() AS "Runs",
       round(sum(query_duration_ms) / 1000, 1) AS "Total seconds",
       round(avg(query_duration_ms)) AS "Avg ms",
       round(quantile(0.99)(query_duration_ms)) AS "p99 ms",
       sum(read_rows) AS "Rows read",
       formatReadableSize(sum(read_bytes)) AS "Bytes read"
FROM system.query_log
WHERE type = 'QueryFinish' AND $__dateTimeFilter(event_date, event_time)
GROUP BY normalized_query_hash
ORDER BY "Total seconds" DESC
LIMIT 20

config.name: Insert throughput
config.sqlTemplate:
SELECT toStartOfInterval(event_time, INTERVAL $__interval_s SECOND) AS ts,
       avg(ProfileEvent_InsertedRows) AS "Rows per second",
       avg(ProfileEvent_InsertedBytes) AS "Bytes per second"
FROM merge('system', '^metric_log')
WHERE $__dateTimeFilter(event_date, event_time)
GROUP BY ts
ORDER BY ts

config.name: Insert back-pressure
config.sqlTemplate:
SELECT toStartOfInterval(event_time, INTERVAL $__interval_s SECOND) AS ts,
       avg(CurrentMetric_DelayedInserts) AS "Delayed inserts",
       sum(ProfileEvent_RejectedInserts) AS "Rejected inserts",
       avg(CurrentMetric_PendingAsyncInsert) AS "Pending async inserts"
FROM merge('system', '^metric_log')
WHERE $__dateTimeFilter(event_date, event_time)
GROUP BY ts
ORDER BY ts

config.name: Parts
config.sqlTemplate:
SELECT toStartOfInterval(event_time, INTERVAL $__interval_s SECOND) AS ts,
       maxIf(value, metric = 'MaxPartCountForPartition') AS "Max per partition",
       avgIf(value, metric = 'TotalPartsOfMergeTreeTables') AS "Total MergeTree parts"
FROM merge('system', '^asynchronous_metric_log')
WHERE metric IN ('MaxPartCountForPartition', 'TotalPartsOfMergeTreeTables')
  AND $__dateTimeFilter(event_date, event_time)
GROUP BY ts
ORDER BY ts

config.name: Merge activity
config.sqlTemplate:
SELECT toStartOfInterval(event_time, INTERVAL $__interval_s SECOND) AS ts,
       avg(CurrentMetric_Merge) AS "Merges running",
       avg(ProfileEvent_MergedRows) AS "Merged rows per second"
FROM merge('system', '^metric_log')
WHERE $__dateTimeFilter(event_date, event_time)
GROUP BY ts
ORDER BY ts

config.name: CPU
config.sqlTemplate:
SELECT toStartOfInterval(event_time, INTERVAL $__interval_s SECOND) AS ts,
       avg(ProfileEvent_OSCPUVirtualTimeMicroseconds) / 1000000 AS "Cores used",
       avg(ProfileEvent_OSCPUWaitMicroseconds) / 1000000 AS "CPU wait",
       avg(ProfileEvent_OSIOWaitMicroseconds) / 1000000 AS "IO wait"
FROM merge('system', '^metric_log')
WHERE $__dateTimeFilter(event_date, event_time)
GROUP BY ts
ORDER BY ts

config.name: Memory
config.sqlTemplate:
SELECT toStartOfInterval(event_time, INTERVAL $__interval_s SECOND) AS ts,
       avg(CurrentMetric_MemoryTracking) AS "Tracked by ClickHouse",
       avg(CurrentMetric_MergesMutationsMemoryTracking) AS "Merges and mutations"
FROM merge('system', '^metric_log')
WHERE $__dateTimeFilter(event_date, event_time)
GROUP BY ts
ORDER BY ts

config.name: Disk and filesystem reads
config.sqlTemplate:
SELECT toStartOfInterval(event_time, INTERVAL $__interval_s SECOND) AS ts,
       avg(ProfileEvent_OSReadBytes) AS "Read from disk",
       avg(ProfileEvent_OSReadChars) AS "Read from filesystem",
       avg(ProfileEvent_OSWriteBytes) AS "Written to disk"
FROM merge('system', '^metric_log')
WHERE $__dateTimeFilter(event_date, event_time)
GROUP BY ts
ORDER BY ts

config.name: Concurrent connections
config.sqlTemplate:
SELECT toStartOfInterval(event_time, INTERVAL $__interval_s SECOND) AS ts,
       max(CurrentMetric_TCPConnection) AS "Native",
       max(CurrentMetric_HTTPConnection) AS "HTTP",
       max(CurrentMetric_InterserverConnection) AS "Interserver"
FROM merge('system', '^metric_log')
WHERE $__dateTimeFilter(event_date, event_time)
GROUP BY ts
ORDER BY ts

config.name: Errors over time
config.sqlTemplate:
SELECT $__timeInterval(event_time) AS ts,
       error AS "Error",
       sum(value) AS "Count"
FROM system.error_log
WHERE $__dateTimeFilter(event_date, event_time)
GROUP BY ts, error
ORDER BY ts

config.name: Errors by name
config.sqlTemplate:
SELECT error AS "Error",
       any(code) AS "Code",
       sum(value) AS "Count",
       max(last_error_time) AS "Last seen",
       any(last_error_message) AS "Last message"
FROM system.error_log
WHERE $__dateTimeFilter(event_date, event_time)
GROUP BY error
ORDER BY "Count" DESC
LIMIT 20
